name: @pipeworx/mcp-speedrun

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search the Speedrun.com database for games by name. Returns matching games with their ID (needed for get_categories and get_leaderboard), abbreviation, release year, and weblink. Example: search_games({ query: "super mario 64", max: 5 })

query.description: Game name or keyword to search for, e.g. "super mario 64", "celeste"

max.description: Maximum number of games to return (default 10)

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List the run categories for a game (e.g. "Any%", "100%", "Glitchless"). Use the game ID from search_games. Each category has an ID needed to fetch a leaderboard via get_leaderboard. Example: get_categories({ game_id: "o1y9wo6q" })

game_id.description: Speedrun.com game ID, as returned by search_games (e.g. "o1y9wo6q")

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch the world-record / top-N leaderboard for a specific game category. Returns ranked runs with finish times (ISO-8601 duration plus seconds), run date, players, and weblink. Get game_id from search_games and category_id from get_categories. Example: get_leaderboard({ game_id: "o1y9wo6q", category_id: "7kjpp4k3", top: 10 })

game_id.description: Speedrun.com game ID, as returned by search_games

category_id.description: Speedrun.com category ID, as returned by get_categories

top.description: Number of top-ranked runs to return (default 10)

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

tools.name: find_user
tools.description: Look up a speedrunner by username. Returns matching users with their ID, display name, and profile weblink. Example: find_user({ name: "cheese05" })

name.description: Speedrunner username to look up, e.g. "cheese05"

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-speedrun forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the speedrun pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
